services.name: Classic Afternoon Sail Aboard Adirondack
services.desc: Our classic afternoon sails are the perfect way to see the sights of Rhode Island. Experience Newport like you never have on a sail aboard the Schooner Adirondack. A smooth, gentle sailing vessel with some speediness to boot, the Adirondack offers a comfortable ride that is brisk and invigorating. Within minutes of leaving the dock, you'll forget the distractions of life on land, as you experience the joy of a leisurely sailing cruise. Enjoy the idyllic scenery of Newport Harbor and Narragansett Bay, as you: Feel the salty ocean breeze and bask in warm sun rays See Newport Bridge - New England's largest suspension bridge Take in views of historic lighthouses including Newport Harbor light

services.desc: Rise and shine, you're in Newport, RI! Start your day with a brisk, invigorating sail aboard Adirondack. Feel free to bring a brunch on this early day sail - our crew completes your experience with perfectly poured Mimosas. First mimosa is $3!
